Class FutureScenarioRegistry

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.procedural.FutureScenarioRegistry
public class FutureScenarioRegistry extends Object
Deterministic Future Physical Scenario Registry. Formalizes initial physical forcing terms (desequilibres physiques de départ) for future projections:
  1. Business As Usual (SSP5-8.5): High CO2 emissions (+4.5°C), zero fusion, continuous NPK depletion.
  2. Technological Singularity invalid input: '&' Fusion: Breakthrough D-T Fusion (EROEI >= 40:1), ASI throughput (>= 10^16 bits/s).
  3. Nuclear Winter Catastrophe: Stratospheric soot injection (τ = 1.5), solar attenuation (S_0 * e^-τ).
  4. AMOC Collapse invalid input: '&' Tipping Point: Freshwater ice melt drops ocean salinity (invalid input: '<' 30 PSU), triggering AMOC shutdown.
  5. Peak Phosphorus Agricultural Cliff: Geological exhaustion of rock phosphate (P), triggering Liebig minimum collapse.
  6. Space Terraforming invalid input: '&' Off-World Colony: Low gravity (g_rel = 0.38), artificial greenhouse P_atmo.
